title: Workshop on Economics and Information Security (WEIS) Archive
summary: There’s a new archive of all the papers from twenty-five years of the Workshop on Economics and Information Security (WEIS). Really nice resource. It’s fun to reread my 2002 essay on the economics of information security.
content:
